conventions.errorBody: error/forbidden/unauthorized/validationError/repoArchivedError/invalidTopicsError are declared as response HEADERS in the swagger; converted to body fields (convertedFromHeader: true) per SPEC-0004 §2.5
conventions.emptyBody: notFound/empty/conflict responses and inline description-only responses carry no body (kind: empty)
conventions.pagination: pagination records the runtime Link/X-Total-Count exception for list operations; declaredHeaders carries the X-* family the contract itself declares (CommitList/ChangedFileList)
